title: Grid Tech Market Map config
description: Editor-supplied configuration for the grid-tech-market-map widget. Every field is optional; widget falls back to documented defaults.

defaultCategory.description: Category to show on first render. Must match a category id present in the widget's bundled data set.

lockCategory.description: When true, the category selector is hidden and only the default category renders. Useful when editors want to embed a single fixed view.
